title: Death SlotBan
description: SlotBan is a unique survival plugin where players lose inventory slots instead of lives, use Slot Tokens to recover slots, and are automatically banned when no usable slots remain.
body:
# SlotBan

SlotBan is a unique survival plugin that replaces traditional lives with inventory slots.

Instead of losing hearts or lives, players lose access to inventory slots. Locked slots become unusable until they are unlocked with Slot Tokens. As players continue to lose slots, inventory management becomes increasingly difficult and every decision matters.

Once a player reaches **0 available slots**, they are automatically banned from the server.

## Features

- Lock and unlock inventory slots
- Slot Token system
- Withdraw slots into tradable tokens
- Automatic bans when no slots remain
- Persistent player data
- Protected armor slots
- Simple and lightweight
- Fully configurable
- Perfect for SMPs, Hardcore servers, Events, and Challenges

## Commands

### Player Commands
- `/slots`
- `/slots status`
- `/slots withdraw`

### Admin Commands
- `/slotsadmin <player> lock`
- `/slotsadmin <player> unlock`
- `/slotsadmin <player> unlockall`
- `/slotsadmin <player> reset`
- `/slotsadmin <player> givetoken`
- `/slotsadmin <player> status`

## How It Works

1. Players start with a limited number of available inventory slots.
2. Slots can be locked through gameplay or administrative actions.
3. Slot Tokens can be used to unlock lost slots.
4. Players must manage their inventory carefully as available space decreases.
5. If a player reaches 0 usable slots, they are automatically banned.

## Perfect For

- SMP Servers
- Hardcore Servers
- Lifesteal Inspired Servers
- Community Events
- Challenge Servers
- Content Creator Events

Challenge your players with a completely new way to survive. Every slot matters. Every item matters. Every decision matters.
